packages.name: Northgate HUD
packages.description:
A HUD your players build themselves.

Status icons, speedometers for every vehicle type, info cards and a death screen. Every player sets it up their way in game, and the server owner changes the defaults without touching a file.

5 status styles  |  3 speedometers  |  4 vehicle types  |  83 in-game settings

Highlights

  • Player settings menu: /hud or F7 opens a full menu. Choices are saved on each player's PC.
  • Edit mode: Drag any part of the HUD to move it, scroll to resize it, right-click to hide it.
  • Every vehicle covered: Separate speedometers for cars, motorbikes, boats and aircraft. Knots and altitude where it makes sense.
  • Built-in seatbelt: Buckle with B, can't climb out while belted, ejection in crashes, warning beeps.
  • Built-in stress: Shooting and speeding raise stress, with camera shake and blur. qb-hud's stress events keep working.
  • Death screen: Heartbeat line, countdown ring, help and respawn prompts and the number of medics on duty.

Screenshots

Full feature list

Status

  • Health, armour, hunger, thirst, stamina, stress, oxygen and a voice indicator
  • Five styles: Hexagon, Circle, Square, Bars and Fill
  • Colour picker for every stat and the accent colour

Vehicles

  • Classic ring, Street digital and Analogue needle speedometers
  • Picked separately for cars, motorbikes, boats and aircraft
  • mph or km/h for road vehicles, knots and altitude for boats and aircraft
  • Fuel and engine readouts

Info cards

  • Date and time, player ID
  • Job and rank, gang
  • Cash, bank and dirty money
  • Radio channel, weapon and ammo

Effects

  • Bleed effect around the screen edge on a big hit
  • Stress camera shake and blur at high levels
  • Performance modes: Low (500 ms), Balanced (200 ms), High (100 ms)

Death screen

  • Works with qbx_medical, qb-ambulancejob and esx_ambulancejob
  • Shows the countdown, help and respawn prompts, medics on duty
  • Optional colour drain while you are down
  • /deathscreenpreview lets admins check it for 15 seconds

Commands and keys

  • /hud (F7): Open the settings menu
  • /togglehud: Hide or show the whole HUD
  • /seatbelt (B): Buckle or unbuckle (built-in seatbelt)
  • /hudsettings: Owner settings
  • /deathscreenpreview: Admins: preview the death screen

83 settings in game

Change them live with /hudsettings, no restart needed. For example:

  • Default style and colours for new players
  • Speed unit and gauge maximums
  • Seatbelt and stress rules
  • Death screen colours, timers and medic jobs
  • Which info cards exist

Compatibility

  • Framework: QBCore, Qbox, ESX, Standalone
  • Medical: qbx_medical, qb-ambulancejob, esx_ambulancejob
  • Voice: pma-voice

Requires: A supported framework, or none (standalone)

Installing

  1. Put the ng_hud folder in your resources folder.
  2. Add ensure ng_hud to server.cfg, after your framework.
  3. Stop any other HUD (for example qb-hud). Using this seatbelt? Turn off the one in qb-smallresources.
  4. Restart the server and press F7.

Questions

Is it really free?
Yes, free forever, with free updates.

Can players move things around?
Yes. Edit mode lets each player drag, resize and hide every part of the HUD.

Will it clash with my seatbelt script?
Set the built-in seatbelt off and it uses your own script's event instead.

What you get

  • Version 2.3.1, delivered instantly to your Cfx.re account (Portal, Granted assets)
  • Free updates for life
  • Support on our Discord: discord.gg/2m69UZSduy
  • Full docs and changelog: northgatestudios.co.uk

packages.name: Northgate Garages
packages.description:
See the real car before you take it out.

Garages, impound lots and rentals with a live 3D preview: the actual model, colours and mods parked in front of you. Create everything in game, share fleets with your gang or job, and sell cars to other players safely.

3D live preview  |  6 key scripts supported  |  5 fuel scripts supported  |  50 in-game settings

Highlights

  • Live preview: Browse your cars and the real one appears in the bay. Drag to spin it, Enter to take it out.
  • Built in game: /garageadmin: walk to a spot, press E. Add spawn points, preview spot, NPC, blip and access.
  • Shared fleets: Give a garage jobs, gangs or citizen IDs and set it as shared: gang cars, police motor pool, company vans.
  • Rentals: Rental points with prices, live preview, time limits and refunds on return.
  • Safe trading: Give or sell a car to a nearby player. They get 30 seconds to accept; the server checks everything twice.
  • Impound and lost cars: /impound [fee] for police and mechanics. Destroyed cars can be recovered at the impound lot.

Screenshots

Full feature list

Garage menu

  • Search by name or plate, filter by All / Ready / Out / Impound
  • Class, seats, plate, fuel, engine and body condition
  • Top speed, acceleration, braking and traction
  • Nicknames for your cars, mileage counted on the server

Garage types

  • Cars, boats and aircraft
  • Public, job, gang and private (citizen ID) garages
  • Shared fleets: anyone with access can take any car stored there
  • Impound lots with fees, and a fee to move a car between garages

Admin menu

  • Create, edit, delete and teleport to garages and rentals
  • Lookup by player, citizen ID or plate: return, impound, change owner, delete
  • Give a vehicle to an online player
  • Name add-on cars in game
  • Logs of every admin action and car sale, plus Discord webhook

Rules

  • Cap on cars out per player
  • What happens to cars left out after a restart: impound, garage or nothing
  • Transfer fees, impound fees, lost-car fee

Look

  • Accent, background, rows, borders, text and status colours
  • Corner roundness, left or right side, size
  • Your own logo
  • Ready-made purple, red, green, gold and mono themes

Commands and keys

  • E (E): Open a garage, store a vehicle
  • /garageadmin: Admin menu
  • /impound [fee]: Police and mechanics: impound the vehicle next to you
  • /garagesettings: Owner settings

50 settings in game

Change them live with /garagesettings, no restart needed. For example:

  • Theme colours and logo
  • Transfer, impound and lost-car fees
  • Cars out per player
  • Rentals: limits, refunds, time
  • Admin webhook (never sent to players)

Compatibility

  • Framework: QBCore, Qbox, ESX
  • Target: ox_target, qb-target
  • Keys: qbx_vehiclekeys, qb-vehiclekeys, wasabi_carlock, MrNewbVehicleKeys, Renewed-Vehiclekeys, qs-vehiclekeys, Northgate Keys
  • Fuel: ox_fuel, LegacyFuel, cdn-fuel, ps-fuel, lc_fuel
  • Text prompts: ox_lib, QBCore DrawText, esx_textui

Requires: oxmysql, OneSync (vehicles are spawned by the server), qb-core, qbx_core or es_extended

Security

  • Only your own cars are ever sent to your game
  • A car can never be out twice, even with two requests at once
  • Health is read from the server's copy of the car: no free repairs
  • Money is only taken once the car has spawned
  • Sales are checked again when the buyer accepts

Installing

  1. Put ng_garages in your resources folder.
  2. Add ensure ng_garages after your framework, oxmysql, fuel and keys scripts.
  3. Stop any other garage script (qb-garages, qbx_garages, esx_garage). Only one should run.
  4. Start the server. Players keep all their vehicles: it uses your framework's own vehicle table.
  5. Use /garageadmin to add garages and rentals.

Questions

Do add-on cars work?
Yes. Every car a player owns is listed, as long as it is streamed on your server. Name them in game if they show a code.

Will my players lose their cars?
No. It uses player_vehicles / owned_vehicles, so every car stays.

Can I use my own logo and colours?
Yes, all from the theme settings.

packages.name: Northgate Staff Panel
packages.description:
Run your whole server from one panel.

A staff panel with an anti-cheat and a staff website built in. Player management, live screens, a live map, reports and tickets, bans with appeals, ranks synced from Discord, and full server control, in six languages.

9 live screens at once  |  6 languages  |  6 frameworks  |  63 in-game settings

Highlights

  • Staff website: The same panel in a browser, hosted by your FiveM server. Staff log in with Discord.
  • Anti-cheat: Server-side checks for explosions, spawning, godmode, teleporting and more. Off / Alert / Kick / Ban each.
  • Live screens: Watch up to 9 players' screens at once, refreshing every 1.5 seconds.
  • Live map: Every player on a satellite map, coloured by state. Click a dot for their profile.
  • Tickets and reports: Reports for now, tickets that last between sessions, quick replies and staff notes.
  • Bans and appeals: Banned players appeal on the website; staff accept or deny with a reply.

Screenshots

Full feature list

Players

  • Go to, bring, send back, spectate, freeze, heal, revive, fix vehicle, screenshot
  • Warn, kick, ban with set durations, admin jail that survives logging off
  • Give money, items, jobs, a temporary or permanent vehicle
  • Inventory and owned vehicles: add, take, clear, return to garage

Anti-cheat

  • Blocked explosions and explosion spam, mass spawning, blocked models and weapons
  • Godmode, health/armour above max, speed, teleport, invisibility
  • Noclip, super jump, spectate, damage boosts on the player's game
  • Unknown resources, mod menu commands, stopped resources, silent anti-cheat
  • Screenshot evidence taken the moment something is detected
  • Sudden money and item alerts to catch duplication

Staff

  • Rank editor with permissions and colours
  • Discord role sync: give a role, get the rank
  • Staff chat in game, in the panel and on the website
  • Duty time, actions, reports and tickets closed per staff member

History and logs

  • Everyone who ever joined: names, identifiers, playtime, joins
  • Warnings, bans, notes, detections and tickets per player
  • Logs of staff actions, bans, reports, joins, deaths, money, items and chat
  • Discord webhooks

Server

  • Scheduled and daily restarts with warnings (txAdmin restarts it)
  • Rotating announcements
  • Start, stop and restart resources (protected ones locked)
  • Weather and time, revive all, clean up vehicles, peds and objects

Commands and keys

  • /staff (F9): Open the staff panel
  • /report [message]: Anyone: report to staff
  • /ticket: Anyone: open the help desk
  • /sc [message]: Staff chat
  • /duty: Go on or off duty
  • /noclip: Noclip
  • /tpm: Teleport to waypoint
  • /announce [message]: Server-wide banner
  • /staffsettings: Owner settings
  • ngban / ngunban / ngids (console): Ban, unban and look up identifiers from the console

63 settings in game

Change them live with /staffsettings, no restart needed. For example:

  • Anti-cheat actions per check
  • Economy alert limits
  • Jail location and release point
  • Restart times and warnings
  • Webhooks (never sent to players)

Compatibility

  • Framework: Qbox, QBCore, ESX, ox_core, ND_Core, Standalone
  • Inventory: ox_inventory, qs-inventory, qb-inventory, ps-inventory, lj-inventory, ESX
  • Storage: oxmysql, or JSON files
  • Screenshots: screenshot-basic
  • Languages: English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Dutch

Requires: Optional: oxmysql (otherwise JSON files), Optional: screenshot-basic for screenshots and live screens, Optional: a Discord app for the website and role sync

Security

  • Every action re-checks the staff member's permission on the server
  • You can only edit ranks below your own and give permissions you have
  • Website sessions end the moment a rank is taken away
  • Discord secrets and webhooks stay on the server

Installing

  1. Put ng_admin in your resources and ensure it after your framework, inventory and oxmysql.
  2. Make yourself staff: add_ace identifier.discord:YOUR_ID ng_admin.owner allow
  3. For screenshots and live screens, ensure screenshot-basic before ng_admin.

  5. Restart and press F9. Set up the website and Discord sync when you're ready.

Yes, standalone mode works; framework features switch on when one is found.

Where is the website hosted?
On your FiveM server itself, at its free users.cfx.re address, or your own domain.

Will the anti-cheat ban my staff?
Staff with the bypass permission skip the player checks. Run new checks on Alert for a week first.

packages.name: Northgate Keys
packages.description:
Keys, locks and getaway cars.

Lock and unlock, engines that need keys, hotwiring, lockpicking, locked street cars and carjacking at gunpoint. Job cars share keys by plate, and other scripts can give keys with the usual events.

packages.name: Northgate Mechanic
packages.description:
A mechanic job that runs like a business.

A workshop tablet, third eye repairs, workshops placed in game, repairs that use the shop's parts stock, invoices with commission, flatbed towing, repair kits for everyone and calls from players. Each shop can be its own business with its own job and funds.

Watch it in game

▶ Play the gameplay video

4 repair types  |  3 repair kit items  |  20% default commission  |  37 in-game settings

Highlights

  • Workshop tablet (F6): Vehicle check, invoice history and customer calls in one MDT.
  • Third eye repairs: Look at a car to repair the engine, body or tyres, wash it, fix it at the roadside or load it onto a flatbed.
  • Workshops: Place duty, garage, boss menu and the workshop area in game. Run several shops as separate businesses.
  • Parts stock: Repairs use parts. The boss buys more from the shop's funds.
  • Invoices: Customers get a Pay / Decline window. The mechanic keeps a commission, the shop gets the rest.
  • Towing: Load the closest car onto a flatbed and drop it off anywhere.
  • Roadside fixes: Out on a call, mechanics can patch an engine up without the workshop.
  • Calls: /callmechanic alerts mechanics on duty with your location.

Screenshots

Full feature list

Repairs

  • Engine, bodywork, tyres and wash, each with its own parts and time
  • Full repairs inside the workshop, roadside fix outside
  • Applied by the game that controls the car, so everyone sees it

Business

  • Invoices up to a limit you set, with commission
  • Parts bought from shop funds, with a stock cap
  • Hire, fire and change grades, deposit and withdraw funds

Vehicles

  • Flatbed, tow truck and service van by grade
  • Shop plates (MECH) and keys handed over automatically

For everyone

  • Repair kit: engine back up to 60%
  • Advanced kit: full engine and tyres
  • Cleaning kit
  • /callmechanic with a message

Commands and keys

  • /mechanic (F6): Workshop tablet
  • Third eye (Alt): Repairs and towing on a car
  • /callmechanic [msg]: Anyone: call a mechanic
  • /mechanicadmin: Place shops (admins)
  • /mechanicsettings: Owner settings

37 settings in game

Change them live with /mechanicsettings, no restart needed. For example:

  • Parts and time for each repair
  • Roadside fix rules
  • Part price and stock cap
  • Invoice limit and commission
  • Repair kit items and strength

Compatibility

  • Framework: QBCore, Qbox, ESX
  • Banking: Renewed-Banking, qb-banking, qb-management, esx_addonaccount, or its own funds table
  • Inventory: ox_inventory, qb-inventory, ESX
  • Fuel: ox_fuel, LegacyFuel, cdn-fuel
  • Target: ox_target, qb-target

Requires: oxmysql, qb-core, qbx_core or es_extended, A mechanic job with a boss grade

Security

  • Duty, distance, workshop area, parts and repair time checked on the server
  • Invoices can only be paid by the person they were sent to
  • Repairs can't be rushed

Installing

  1. Put ng_mechanic in your resources and ensure it after your framework and oxmysql.
  2. Make sure your mechanic job exists, with a boss grade.
  3. /mechanicadmin to move the shop points or add more shops.
  4. Add the repair kit items to your inventory (ox_inventory snippet in the README).

Questions

Can I run LS Customs and Benny's as different businesses?
Yes. Each shop belongs to its own job, with its own funds and stock.

Do players need a mechanic online?
No. Repair kits work for everyone.

packages.name: Northgate Housing
packages.description:
Homes for everyone, no MLOs needed.

Buy or rent homes at any front door. Every home is a private copy of a GTA interior, so a hundred houses can share one. Keys, doorbells, storage, wardrobe, furniture, a real estate job with its own tablet, and police raids.

Watch it in game

▶ Play the gameplay video

20 interiors included  |  38 furniture items  |  8 keys per home  |  25 in-game settings

Highlights

  • No MLOs: GTA's own apartments and Vinewood Hills houses. Each home is private.
  • Buy or rent: Buy outright, or rent by the day paid in advance. Unpaid tenants are evicted after the grace days.
  • Real estate job: An agency tablet for listings, clients, offers to nearby players and sales history. Agents earn commission.
  • Furniture: 38 items in 10 categories. A see-through preview follows where you look: turn it, raise it, press E.
  • Storage and wardrobe: Put them anywhere in your home. Works with your inventory and clothing script.
  • Raids: Police breach the door with a kick animation and a crash heard inside and out, then open the storage.
  • Easy to use: G leaves the house from anywhere inside. /house shows your homes and houses for sale with GPS.

Screenshots

Full feature list

Living

  • Lock and unlock, doorbell with a "Let in" button
  • Give and take back keys (up to 8 people)
  • Sell back to the market or give the house to someone
  • Tenants top up rent or end the lease

Interiors

  • 20 interiors: studios, apartments, high-rises, a trailer, Hills houses and a mansion
  • The casino penthouse
  • Add any coordinates of your own: an MLO you own or a shell you placed

Market

  • Agents and admins list houses with price and daily rent
  • Sales go to the agency funds, agent gets commission
  • Limit on homes per character

Safety

  • Logging in after a crash inside puts you at the front door
  • Only owners and tenants place furniture (unless you allow key holders)
  • Everything saved to the database (or the server's storage)

Commands and keys

  • E / /house (E): House menu, or your homes and houses for sale
  • Leave (G): Leave the house from anywhere inside
  • /realestate: Agency tablet (agents on duty and admins)
  • /housingsettings: Owner settings

25 settings in game

Change them live with /housingsettings, no restart needed. For example:

  • Homes per character, sell-back share
  • Renting on or off, days ahead, grace days
  • Storage slots and weight
  • Furniture limits and refunds
  • Raid jobs, item and time

Compatibility

  • Framework: QBCore, Qbox, ESX
  • Inventory: ox_inventory, qb-inventory, qs-inventory, ps-inventory, lj-inventory
  • Clothing: illenium-appearance, fivem-appearance, qb-clothing, esx_skin
  • Banking: Renewed-Banking, qb-banking, qb-management, esx_addonaccount

Requires: oxmysql, qb-core, qbx_core or es_extended

Security

  • Every purchase, rent payment and key change checked on the server
  • Furniture positions checked to be inside the home
  • Private interiors per house: no walking into someone else's

Installing

  1. Put ng_housing in your resources and ensure it after your framework, oxmysql and inventory.
  2. Optional: a realestate job with a boss grade. Admins can always list houses.
  3. Stand at a front door, /realestate, fill in name, interior and price.

Questions

Do I need shells or MLOs?
No. It uses GTA's built-in interiors. You can add your own if you want.

What happens to offline tenants?
Rent is paid in advance. When it runs out, they have the grace days to top it up.

packages.name: Northgate Complete Pack
packages.description:
All 8 paid Northgate scripts in one purchase.

Police, Housing, Mechanic, Robberies, Keys, Vehicle Shop, Garages and the Staff Panel. They are built to work together: police raid houses, mechanics fix cars from the vehicle shop, keys work with every garage, and the staff panel watches all of it. One payment, every script delivered to your Cfx.re account, with free updates for life.

▶ Watch every script in game on our website

What's inside

Northgate Police (v1.1.2): Everything a police department needs. A full MDT tablet, third eye actions on players and cars, arrests, fines and jail with records, real evidence, armoury and garage by rank, speed radar and plate reader, panic button and dispatch, management and funds. Stations are placed in game by walking to each spot.

  • MDT tablet (F6): People and vehicle lookups, reports, warrants, charges, notes, live dispatch calls and a boss page.
  • Third eye: Look at a player to cuff, escort, search, seat, seize cash, fine or jail. Look at a car to run the plate.
  • Break free: The person being cuffed gets a quick skill check to escape. Difficulty is up to you.
  • Fines and jail: Pick charges from a list. Jail survives logging out, and prison jobs take time off.

Northgate Housing (v1.2.2): Homes for everyone, no MLOs needed. Buy or rent homes at any front door. Every home is a private copy of a GTA interior, so a hundred houses can share one. Keys, doorbells, storage, wardrobe, furniture, a real estate job with its own tablet, and police raids.

  • No MLOs: GTA's own apartments and Vinewood Hills houses. Each home is private.
  • Buy or rent: Buy outright, or rent by the day paid in advance. Unpaid tenants are evicted after the grace days.
  • Real estate job: An agency tablet for listings, clients, offers to nearby players and sales history. Agents earn commission.
  • Furniture: 38 items in 10 categories. A see-through preview follows where you look: turn it, raise it, press E.

Northgate Mechanic (v1.1.1): A mechanic job that runs like a business. A workshop tablet, third eye repairs, workshops placed in game, repairs that use the shop's parts stock, invoices with commission, flatbed towing, repair kits for everyone and calls from players. Each shop can be its own business with its own job and funds.

  • Workshop tablet (F6): Vehicle check, invoice history and customer calls in one MDT.
  • Third eye repairs: Look at a car to repair the engine, body or tyres, wash it, fix it at the roadside or load it onto a flatbed.
  • Workshops: Place duty, garage, boss menu and the workshop area in game. Run several shops as separate businesses.
  • Parts stock: Repairs use parts. The boss buys more from the shop's funds.

Northgate Robberies (v1.1.0): Every robbery, on any map. Store tills and safes, ATMs, Vangelico, all six Fleeca vaults and house burglaries. It uses GTA's own tills, safes, ATMs, cases and vault doors, so it works on any map straight away.

  • Store tills and safes: Any 24/7, LTD or liquor store. Lockpick the till, crack the safe dial by feel.
  • ATMs: Brute-force any ATM in the world.
  • Vangelico: Smash the cases with a weapon. They stay smashed for everyone until the cooldown ends.
  • Fleeca vaults: Thermite and hack the vault door (it really swings open for everyone), then drill the deposit boxes.

Northgate Keys (v1.1.1): Keys, locks and getaway cars. Lock and unlock, engines that need keys, hotwiring, lockpicking, locked street cars and carjacking at gunpoint. Job cars share keys by plate, and other scripts can give keys with the usual events.

  • Lock and unlock: L locks and unlocks with the key fob animation, lights and sound.
  • Engine needs keys: G turns the engine on or off. No keys, no engine.
  • Hotwiring: H in a car without keys: strip the wires, connect the right ones, then crank the engine.
  • Lockpicking: Set each pin in the right order with a real tension wrench. Fail and the pick might break.

Northgate Vehicle Shop (v1.1.1): Showrooms, finance and tuning in one script. Dealerships with a live 3D showroom, test drives and finance, plus mechanic shops for performance and visual upgrades. Five dealerships and five mechanic shops come ready, and you can add more in game.

  • 3D showroom: Spin and zoom the real car, pick colours, compare two cars side by side.
  • Test drives: Timed test drives with their own plates.
  • Finance: Down payment, then automatic payments from the bank. Missed payments take the car back.
  • Mechanic shops: Engine, brakes, gearbox, suspension, armour, turbo, paint, wheels, body, lights, tint, plates and repairs.

Northgate Garages (v1.2.1): See the real car before you take it out. Garages, impound lots and rentals with a live 3D preview: the actual model, colours and mods parked in front of you. Create everything in game, share fleets with your gang or job, and sell cars to other players safely.

  • Live preview: Browse your cars and the real one appears in the bay. Drag to spin it, Enter to take it out.
  • Built in game: /garageadmin: walk to a spot, press E. Add spawn points, preview spot, NPC, blip and access.
  • Shared fleets: Give a garage jobs, gangs or citizen IDs and set it as shared: gang cars, police motor pool, company vans.
  • Rentals: Rental points with prices, live preview, time limits and refunds on return.

Northgate Staff Panel (v1.4.2): Run your whole server from one panel. A staff panel with an anti-cheat and a staff website built in. Player management, live screens, a live map, reports and tickets, bans with appeals, ranks synced from Discord, and full server control, in six languages.

  • Staff website: The same panel in a browser, hosted by your FiveM server. Staff log in with Discord.
  • Anti-cheat: Server-side checks for explosions, spawning, godmode, teleporting and more. Off / Alert / Kick / Ban each.
  • Live screens: Watch up to 9 players' screens at once, refreshing every 1.5 seconds.
  • Live map: Every player on a satellite map, coloured by state. Click a dot for their profile.

Compatibility

Every script works with QBCore, Qbox and ESX, and with the common inventories, targets and banking scripts. Each script's page on our website lists the full details.
